content: Paulo be Banaba ꞌidi loguguya Ikoniami ꞌena

Paulo be Banaba siapwesa Ikoniami ꞌena, ga ꞌidi guinuwa Anitioki ꞌena wate nadigega Ikoniami ꞌena siguinuwaꞌesa, nate me Yudia ꞌidi anuwa tapwalolo ꞌena siluguya ga sieꞌita, ta ma idi eꞌita waiwai, ꞌenega boda yaudi siemisedi, boda nidi ꞌaidi me Yudia ta ꞌaidi mali senao ꞌediyega.

Ta saꞌi ꞌaidi me Yudia eꞌita nina nigeya siemisena, ta sisinalina ga siꞌawa toꞌumaliyena, ga sitauya taudi nigeya me Yudia ꞌediya ga silomugi Paulo be Banaba manudi, ꞌenega taudi wate Paulo be Banaba sietalauwaledi.

Ta tuwa tuga, tuta dudulana Paulo be Banaba simiyana sena nina ꞌena, ta ma idi ꞌatepatu siloguloguguya ꞌInapwana manuna. Ga ꞌInapwana nina ꞌina waiwaiyega guinuwa ꞌebe nuwaowana be edeedede siguinuwedi, ga ꞌediyega ꞌInapwana nina ꞌina oboboma tetelina ꞌana ꞌaiꞌaila tauna ꞌieꞌitaena tomota ꞌediya.
Ta saꞌi me Ikoniami nidi siweyala, ga ꞌaidi me Yudia siꞌawa ꞌaiꞌailedi, ta ꞌaidi Yesu ꞌana tosimanao siꞌawa ꞌaiꞌailedi.
ꞌEnega taudi nigeya me Yudia, be me Yudia wate, be ꞌidi ꞌinapwanao maꞌediyao siloina leleleya be Paulo ta Banaba sida gieꞌelouyaedi, nai gulewega sida loemwawasidi.
Ta esiya alena sinonona ga sidena, ga sitauya Lakeonia ꞌasanao ꞌediya, nate Lisitila be Dabi ꞌediya,
ga nada tetela boboꞌana sisimana apwesena, ta ꞌasanao selabediya ꞌediya wate.
Paulo be Banaba ꞌidi guinuwa Lisitila ꞌena
Lisitila ꞌena ꞌebweu tai silobena ꞌina tuta tubuwa ꞌenega ga ꞌietai, ta ꞌimiyamiya namo tuga, ta nigeya ꞌida toolo nai ꞌida adadana, manuna maꞌae lopelopegoina ꞌitubuwa.
Ga tolopegoi nina ꞌimiyatowa, ta Paulo ꞌina loguguya ꞌienoenonoena. ꞌEnega Paulo tolopegoi nina ꞌiduneyena, ga ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene ma ina emisa Yesu ꞌena, be sawesawenaya ꞌida gieboboꞌane,
ꞌenega Paulo ꞌenana sinabwana ꞌenega ꞌibwaunao ꞌena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌUtoolo.” Ta tolopegoi nina ꞌitoolo manini ga ꞌiadadana.
Ta tomota maiboꞌadi Paulo ꞌina guinuwa gete siꞌitena, ga ꞌena Lakeoniyega sibwaubwau, “Yaubadao niꞌatu simwaꞌutama, ꞌadi ꞌita ꞌatuwa tomota.”
Ga pwaluyao Banaba sibwauyena Yupita, ta Paulo sibwauyena Mekiuli, manuna tauna ꞌidi toona. Esanao getedi ꞌidi yaubadao ꞌadi esanao, nate Yupita ta Mekiuli.

Ta ꞌidi yaubada Yupita ꞌina totaliya ꞌasa nina ꞌena ꞌimiyami, ta ꞌina Anuwa Taliya ꞌasa ꞌetaulunaya. ꞌEnega totaliya nina ꞌaina bulumakau be kaiwe senina sulasulana ꞌimeꞌedi ꞌasa ꞌana ꞌawa ꞌena, ta nuwanuwana ꞌaene pwalu maꞌenao sida taliya Paulo be Banaba ꞌediya.
Ta siteluwa nidi niꞌatu totaliya ꞌina nuwanuwa simwalatonina, ga geyanuwa ꞌaiꞌailidi, ꞌenega ꞌadi ꞌoamao sigisabudi ta sipili apwesa boda ꞌediya, sigwaegwae,

“Gosemao, geyaꞌabo ꞌaboꞌama ꞌemaya watalitaliya. ꞌAboꞌama tomota tuga nadigega ꞌomi, ga tetela boboꞌana gete ꞌameꞌena ꞌemiya, be ꞌaene ꞌimi ꞌebe emisa besobeso wada guitoyasedi be wada sanaila Yaubada mayawasina ꞌena, tauna galewa be baleꞌu be bwagabwaga be wate yage maiboꞌadi soladiya ꞌadi tomweluluwa.
Yaubada nina lowa sena yauyaudi tomotenidiyao ꞌitagwaledi, be taudimo ꞌidi nuwanuwao, be ꞌidi bubunao sida muliyedi,

ta saꞌi ꞌebeꞌitao ꞌediya simiyami be ꞌaene ꞌediyega Yaubada nina sida mwalamwalatoni, ta ꞌebeꞌita nidi ꞌina obobomao ꞌediya be ꞌomi ꞌemiya, nate ꞌusana galewega be wate ꞌoelaa boboꞌana, be ꞌediyega sesoi boboꞌadi walobaloba be ꞌenega waꞌeꞌai be manuna wagwaugwausowala.”
Ta Paulo be Banaba tomota nidi siꞌetoboda yogenedi, ta ꞌebe losalowa ꞌena siewaiwai, ga nigeya ꞌediya sitalitaliya.

Ta saꞌi me Yudia Anitioki be Ikoniami ꞌediyega simai, ga silugu boda nidi Paulo ta Banaba ꞌadi toenonoyao soladiya, ga siloꞌae etuetunedi ga Paulo gulewega siloibweibwena, ta ꞌasa solanega silisi apwesena, ta ꞌidi nuwanuwa niꞌatu ꞌimwawasa.
Ga muliyega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao simai ga Paulo sitoolo sakowasiyena, ta Paulo nina ꞌitoolo, ga ꞌilugu limana ꞌasaya. Ta ꞌenega tomwa ꞌiulisina ga Banaba maꞌiyana sitauya Dabi.
Siila Anitioki, nate Silia solanaya
Dabi ꞌena tetela boboꞌana siloguguyaena, ga tomota yaudi siemisena, ga simuliyena, ꞌenega Paulo be Banaba siila limana Lisitila be Ikoniami be Anitioki ꞌediya.

Ta ꞌidi sakowasi nina ꞌena Yesu ꞌana toemisao sigiepaꞌalidi ꞌasa ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediya, ta siloguguyedi be geyaꞌabo ꞌidi emisa ꞌida neeneta, ta sigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila, maꞌetamo ꞌida ꞌelouyao yaudi ꞌediyega talulugu Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌena.”

Ta wate ꞌasa ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediya Paulo be Banaba toekalesiyao ꞌidi toanuganao siaseyedi, ta ꞌadi gilagata gete nadigega, ꞌebotanega ꞌInapwana nina siemisenaya ꞌena sisidasida, be ꞌida giewaiwaiyedi ꞌidi guinuwa nina manuna.
Ta Pisidia solanega simai ga Pamipili ꞌena siapwesa,
ga ꞌasa Peliga ꞌena siloguguya, ꞌenega sidolo Atalaya,
ga wagega sigelu, ga siila Anitioki, sena nina lowa ꞌenega ꞌidi guinuwa nina sieꞌalena, ta ꞌena wate lowa Yaubada ꞌina oboboma silobena, paisewa nina niꞌatu silosalonina manuna.

ꞌEnega tuta nina Anitioki ꞌena siluguya, toekalesiyao sibwau egogonedima, ga yage yauyauna Yaubada ꞌiguinuwenaya manudi, ꞌidi sakowasi nina solanaya siemwasalidi, nate emisa ꞌana ꞌawa ꞌigigegena taudi nigeya me Yudia manudi, be taudi wate sida lugu.
ꞌEnega Paulo be Banaba Yesu ꞌana toemisao sena nina Anitioki ꞌena maꞌediyao simiyamiya tuta dudulana.
